payload.name: Private PDF Tools
payload.description: 私密编辑 PDF 文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Merge and compress PDFs, turn images into PDFs, rename output files, split PDFs, extract selected pages, and rotate PDF pages.

Files are processed locally in your browser. AILabTools does not download, store, or retain your file contents. Depending on the ChatGPT client, you can download the finished file or save it back to ChatGPT.

Use the guided workflow to combine files and reduce file size, or use focused tools for splitting, extracting, and rotating PDF pages.
payload.longDescription:
合并和压缩 PDF、将图片转为 PDF、重命名输出文件、拆分 PDF、提取指定页面并旋转 PDF 页面。

文件会在浏览器本地处理。AILabTools 不会下载、存储或保留你的文件内容。根据所用的 ChatGPT 客户端，你可以下载处理完成的文件，或将其保存回 ChatGPT。

使用引导式工作流合并文件并减小文件体积，也可以使用专用工具拆分、提取和旋转 PDF 页面。

payload.name: Genesys
payload.description: 跨 AI 应用的记忆系统
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history. Trace how memories connect and follow full causal chains from decision to consequence.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.
payload.longDescription:
Genesys 为你的 AI 提供因果记忆图谱——它不是一份记忆事实的清单，而是一个持续演进的网络，其中每条记忆都是一个节点，每种关系都是带类型的因果边，并且每次检索都可以解释。询问某条记忆为何出现，Genesys 会显示其相关性评分、因果关联和重新激活历史。追踪记忆之间的联系，并沿着从决策到结果的完整因果链进行探索。

你的记忆图谱由你掌控：它独立于任何单一 AI 服务商，可与 ChatGPT、Claude 及任何兼容 MCP 的模型以相同方式协同工作，并会在你切换服务时随你迁移。你可以直接管理它——永久固定重要内容，随时检查图谱健康状况，并可在任何时候彻底删除任何内容。

Genesys 基于受神经科学启发的评分方式（相关性 × 因果关联 × 重新激活）构建，能够安全遗忘：只有不相关、因果关系断裂且未固定的记忆才会被清除。

payload.name: Jackpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jackpot connects ChatGPT to your brand asset library so you can search assets, browse visual galleries, inspect collections and executions, prepare chat-safe previews, update metadata, run preview edits, and optionally attach assets to connected destinations you already authorized.
payload.longDescription: Jackpot 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的品牌素材库，让你搜索素材、浏览视觉图库、查看合集和执行项目、准备适合在聊天中查看的预览、更新元数据、运行预览编辑，并可选择将素材附加到你已授权连接的目标位置。

payload.name: AIOProductOS
payload.description: 围绕同一记录开展产品工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AIOProductOS connects ChatGPT to a product workspace where revenue, customer feedback, product analytics, delivery work and code all hang off one shared customer record. Users read the board and the product brain, capture feedback as insights and link it to features, run revenue-weighted NPS, NRR, funnel and retention analysis, manage OKRs, sprints and releases, work the support inbox, and create or update tasks — all against their own authenticated workspace. Because money, behaviour and feedback sit on the same record, users can ask which accounts requested a feature and what they pay, then act on the answer without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: AIOProductOS 将 ChatGPT 连接到产品工作区，营收、客户反馈、产品分析、交付工作和代码都关联到同一份共享客户记录。用户可读取看板和产品知识中心，将反馈记录为洞察并关联到功能，进行营收加权的NPS、NRR、漏斗和留存分析，管理OKR、冲刺和发布，处理支持收件箱，以及创建或更新任务——所有操作都在用户自己已认证的工作区内进行。资金、行为和反馈位于同一记录上，因此用户可询问哪些客户要求某项功能、他们支付了多少钱，然后无需离开对话就能根据答案采取行动。

payload.name: Wazu
payload.description: 搜索并保存 Wazu 记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wazu connects ChatGPT to the user's authorized personal and cohort memory. It can inspect the active Wazu scope, list permitted cohorts, retrieve recent or topic-matched evidence, hydrate complete items and document passages, explore related evidence through Hive Map, retrieve bounded media references, and save user-authorized summaries, text, or media into an explicit cohort.
payload.longDescription: Wazu 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户获授权的个人及群组记忆。它可以检查当前启用的 Wazu 范围、列出获准访问的群组、检索近期或与主题匹配的证据、加载完整条目和文档段落、通过 Hive Map 探索相关证据、检索范围受限的媒体引用，并将用户授权的摘要、文本或媒体保存到指定群组。

payload.name: Ideaflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ideaflow helps users confirm their signed-in account, open their notes app URL, and search, filter, read, list hashtags, link, create, edit, organize, publish, delete, and restore personal notes and folders through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Ideaflow 帮助用户确认已登录账户、打开笔记应用网址，并通过 ChatGPT 搜索、筛选、阅读笔记，列出标签、建立链接，以及创建、编辑、整理、发布、删除和恢复个人笔记与文件夹。

payload.name: Transcriptor
payload.description: 查看视频转录文本和元数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Transcriptor lets ChatGPT work with video the way it works with text. Paste a link from YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion or Reddit and ask for a summary, a quote with its timestamp, the chapter list, the publisher and view counts, or the still frame at a given timecode. Eight read-only tools cover the workflow: cleaned plain-text transcripts with cursor pagination for long videos, raw SRT/VTT subtitles, the list of available caption languages, extended metadata, chapter markers, single frames at any timecode, batch transcripts for selected playlist items, and YouTube search. Four of them render interactive widgets in the chat: a search carousel, a searchable timed transcript, a metadata card, and a frame viewer. The service retrieves only public captions, metadata, thumbnails and single still frames; it never returns or redistributes video or audio files.
payload.longDescription: Transcriptor 让 ChatGPT 像处理文本一样处理视频。粘贴 YouTube、Twitter/X、Instagram、TikTok、Twitch、Vimeo、Facebook、Bilibili、VK、Dailymotion 或 Reddit 链接，然后要求生成摘要、带时间戳的引述、章节列表、发布者和观看次数，或指定时间码的静帧。8 个只读工具覆盖整个流程：支持长视频游标分页的清理后纯文本转录、原始 SRT/VTT 字幕、可用字幕语言列表、扩展元数据、章节标记、任意时间码的单帧、所选播放列表项目的批量转录，以及 YouTube 搜索。其中 4 个工具会在聊天中生成交互式组件：搜索轮播、可搜索的定时转录文本、元数据卡片和画面查看器。该服务仅获取公开字幕、元数据、缩略图和单张静帧；绝不返回或重新分发视频或音频文件。

payload.name: Elodus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Elodus helps teams organize software-development workspaces, read and author structured documents, manage work orders and data models, explore research and grant sources, and maintain connected project artifacts through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Elodus 帮助团队整理软件开发工作区、阅读和撰写结构化文档、管理工作订单与数据模型、探索研究和资助来源，并通过 ChatGPT 维护相互关联的项目资料。

payload.name: Task Tool
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Verify Task Tool availability or create, get, list, and update managed tasks and their private Markdown plans.
payload.longDescription: 验证 Task Tool 是否可用，或创建、获取、列出并更新受管理的任务及其私有 Markdown 计划。

payload.name: Whalesync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whalesync keeps data in sync between the tools your team already uses — Airtable, Webflow, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Postgres, and more — with two-way sync that feels native in every app.

With this app connected, you can build and run syncs by describing them: create a sync between two apps, map tables and fields, validate the mapping, and turn the sync on. Once data is flowing, ask it to monitor things — check sync status, find out why a record isn’t syncing, review pending deletes, and retry failed work after you fix the cause.
payload.longDescription:
Whalesync 可在团队已使用的工具之间同步数据，包括 Airtable、Webflow、HubSpot、Salesforce、Notion、Postgres 等，并在每款应用中提供原生般的双向同步体验。

连接此应用后，你可以通过描述需求来创建并运行同步：在两款应用之间建立同步、映射表格和字段、验证映射并启用同步。数据开始流动后，还可以要求它监控同步情况——检查同步状态、查明某条记录为何未同步、查看待处理的删除操作，并在修复原因后重试失败任务。

payload.name: DeepL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DeepL brings high-accuracy translation into ChatGPT. Translate text across 100+ languages, and translate entire documents (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, HTML, plain text, subtitles, XLIFF) while preserving their original layout and formatting. Glossaries, style rules, and custom instructions from the user's DeepL account are applied to keep terminology and tone consistent, and DeepL Write rephrases or corrects text for grammar, typos, style, and tone. Connects to the user's existing DeepL account via OAuth.
payload.longDescription: DeepL 将高准确度翻译带入 ChatGPT。可在 100+ 种语言之间翻译文本，也可翻译完整文档（Word、PowerPoint、Excel、PDF、HTML、纯文本、字幕、XLIFF），同时保留原有版式和格式。系统会应用用户 DeepL 账户中的术语表、风格规则和自定义指令，以保持术语和语气一致；DeepL Write 还可改写或校正文稿的语法、错字、文风和语气。通过 OAuth 连接用户现有的 DeepL 账户。

payload.name: timr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: timr helps users inspect current activity and balances, review time and mileage records, start or stop timers, add or update entries, and manage multi-day leave through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: timr 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看当前活动和余额、检查工时与里程记录、启动或停止计时器、添加或更新记录，并管理跨多日的休假。

payload.name: Pocket Bartender
payload.description: Pocket Bartender 鸡尾酒配方与调酒应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pocket Bartender is a reference library of 700+ drink recipes — cocktails, shots, punches, coffees, smoothies and 86 non-alcoholic options, including 113 official IBA classics.

Ask for any drink by name and get the full recipe: every ingredient with its measure, numbered method steps, preparation time, ABV, calories and food pairings.

Or list what you have at home — “gin, Campari, sweet vermouth, some limes” — and it works out which drinks you can make right now, and which ones you are a single ingredient away from, so your next purchase is the useful one.

Everything is available in 25 languages, with measures written the way a bartender would say them. Every recipe links back to the Pocket Bartender app for iOS and Android.
payload.longDescription:
Pocket Bartender 是一个包含 700+ 种饮品配方的参考库，涵盖鸡尾酒、烈酒小杯、宾治、咖啡、冰沙和 86 款无酒精饮品，其中包括 113 款 IBA 官方经典配方。

按名称询问任意饮品，即可获取完整配方：每种配料及其用量、编号步骤、准备时间、酒精度、卡路里和搭配食物。

或者列出家里的食材——“金酒、Campari、甜味美思，还有一些青柠”——它会计算您现在可以调制哪些饮品，以及还差一种配料就能制作哪些饮品，让您的下一次采购买得有用。

所有内容提供 25 种语言，计量方式采用调酒师习惯的表达。每个配方都链接回适用于 iOS 和 Android 的 Pocket Bartender 应用。

payload.name: Continuity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep character details, world rules, and story events consistent across ChatGPT conversations. Save approved facts and scene summaries, retrieve them when continuing a story in a new chat, and check drafts against saved canon for contradictions. Save provisional checkpoints for unfinished scenes, unresolved questions, and next steps. Continuity receives only content sent through its tools with your permission. It does not automatically back up entire chats, recover unsaved details, or guarantee error-free writing. Requires an existing Continuity account with Pro or active trial access.
payload.longDescription: 在不同 ChatGPT 对话中保持角色细节、世界规则和故事事件一致。保存已确认的事实与场景摘要，在新聊天续写故事时检索，并检查草稿是否与已保存的正史设定矛盾。还可为未完成场景、悬而未决的问题和后续步骤保存临时检查点。Continuity 只接收你通过其工具并经你许可发送的内容。它不会自动备份完整聊天、找回未保存的细节，也不保证写作绝无错误。需要已有 Continuity 账户，且具备 Pro 方案或有效的试用权限。

payload.name: OSuite.ai
payload.description: 审核有风险的 AI 操作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OSuite.ai helps teams review important AI actions before they happen. It can route risky work into approval, check whether an action is cleared to continue, summarize runtime exposure, and keep an audit-ready record of what was reviewed, approved, and completed.
payload.longDescription: OSuite.ai 帮助团队在重要 AI 操作发生前进行审核。它可以将高风险工作转入审批流程、检查操作是否获准继续、汇总运行时风险，并保留可供审计的记录，记录哪些事项经过审核、批准和完成。

payload.name: Fontis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: O Fontis pesquisa uma base curada de instrumentos jurídicos brasileiros e retorna trechos literais com citação, fonte e status de vigência. A cobertura inclui o Código Civil, o Código de Processo Civil, a CLT, o Código Penal, o Código de Defesa do Consumidor, o Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente, a LGPD, a Lei de Alimentos, a Lei de Registros Públicos, a Lei da União Estável e a Lei da Mulher Casada; as súmulas do STF e do STJ e as súmulas vinculantes; os enunciados das Jornadas de Direito Civil do CJF; o Protocolo do CNJ para Julgamento com Perspectiva de Gênero; e a Tabela de Honorários da OAB/SP. O plugin é voltado a profissionais do Direito que precisam localizar fundamentação rastreável para conferência. Ele não prevê resultados processuais, não substitui aconselhamento jurídico profissional e não cobre direito estrangeiro.
payload.longDescription: Fontis 会搜索经筛选的巴西法律文书数据库，并返回附有引文、来源和现行状态的原文摘录。收录内容包括《民法典》《民事诉讼法》《劳动法典》《刑法典》《消费者保护法》《儿童和青少年法》《通用数据保护法》（LGPD）、《食品法》《公共登记法》《稳定婚姻法》和《已婚妇女法》；STF 和 STJ 判例摘要及具有约束力的判例摘要；CJF 民法会议决议；CNJ《性别视角审判议定书》；以及 OAB/SP 律师费标准表。此插件面向需要查找可追溯法律依据以供核验的法律专业人士。它不会预测诉讼结果，不能替代专业法律建议，也不涵盖外国法。

payload.name: Meetly
payload.description: 把会议转化为实用成果
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meetly by Edge First AI lets users find meetings they explicitly sync and retrieve speaker-tagged evidence. Packaged skills then help the host summarize, research, map, teach, plan, and create product documents with its native capabilities.
payload.longDescription: Edge First AI 出品的 Meetly 帮助用户查找自己明确同步的会议，并调取带有发言者标签的证据。随后可使用配套技能，借助其原生功能进行总结、研究、梳理、教学、规划并创建产品文档。

payload.name: FORTVISION
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FORTVISION brings marketing activity into one workspace. Plan and manage campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn and DV360, track leads, deals and conversations, coordinate email, SMS, WhatsApp and LinkedIn outreach, run automations, and keep landing pages, social posts, coupons, meetings and projects organized in one place.
payload.longDescription: FORTVISION将营销活动整合到一个工作区。在Meta、Google Ads、TikTok、LinkedIn和DV360等平台规划和管理活动，跟踪潜在客户、交易和对话，协调邮件、短信、WhatsApp和LinkedIn推广，运行自动化流程，将着陆页、社交帖子、优惠券、会议和项目在一处整理得井然有序。

payload.name: Jicoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jicoo helps authorized team members inspect bookings, schedules, event types, routing forms, host assignment rules, organization users, meeting artifacts, and webhook endpoint settings through ChatGPT. It also supports creating or updating booking, schedule, event type, routing form, host assignment, and webhook configuration records when the user explicitly asks to make those changes.
payload.longDescription: 经授权的团队成员可以通过 ChatGPT 查看预订、日程、活动类型、路由表单、主持人分配规则、组织用户、会议资料和 webhook 端点设置。当用户明确要求进行更改时，也支持创建或更新预订、日程、活动类型、路由表单、主持人分配和 webhook 配置记录。

payload.name: Axis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Axis helps people track and manage finances, relationships, knowledge, habits, and focus. Its tools read private account data and create, update, or delete records only after OAuth consent.
payload.longDescription: Axis 帮助人们跟踪和管理财务、人际关系、知识、习惯和专注状态。其工具仅在获得 OAuth 同意后，才读取私人账户数据以及创建、更新或删除记录。

payload.name: Jessie Script Director
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A public-submission package for the Jessie Approved Script Director workflow. It guides one creative decision at a time, protects product facts and claims, reviews scripts, and plans Simplified Chinese JiMeng 出镜 prompts while preserving English spoken dialogue
payload.longDescription: 这是 Jessie Approved Script Director 工作流的公开提交软件包。它一次引导你做出一个创意决策，保护产品事实和宣传主张，审阅脚本，并规划简体中文即梦出镜提示词，同时保留英文口播台词。

payload.name: CalendarBridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CalendarBridge is the market leader in calendar syncing and unified scheduling with over 100,000+ users. CalendarBridge keeps all of your calendars’ availability synced in real time and shows them in one unified calendar. With CalendarBridge you always know your availability is up to date across all of your calendars.

Connect Google, Outlook, Apple, and more so you can see every event together and make edits that update instantly across all of your accounts and devices. No more switching between apps, missing updates, or worrying about double bookings. 

Whether you’re tracking work meetings, family plans, school events, or personal appointments, CalendarBridge keeps everything accurate, connected and easy to manage. 
Our patented privacy technology ensures every update is accurate, private, and automatic.

With CalendarBridge, you can:
- Sync availability across multiple calendars in real-time 
- View and edit all connected calendars from a single Unified Calendar
- Share availability with scheduling links, or a booking page

Try CalendarBridge today and experience the easiest way to manage all your calendars in one place. The calendar sync app you never knew you needed, and the one you’ll wonder how you lived without.
payload.longDescription:
CalendarBridge 是日历同步和统一排程领域的市场领导者，拥有超过 100,000+ 名用户。它实时同步所有日历的空闲状态，并在一个统一日历中显示。借助 CalendarBridge，您始终知道各个日历上的最新可用时间。

连接 Google、Outlook、Apple 等账户，即可一起查看所有事件；编辑后会立即同步到所有账户和设备。无需再切换应用、错过更新或担心重复预订。无论是工作会议、家庭计划、学校活动还是个人预约，CalendarBridge

都能让一切准确、连接且易于管理。我们的专利隐私技术确保每次更新准确、私密且自动。
使用 CalendarBridge，您可以：

- 实时同步多个日历的可用时间
- 在一个统一日历中查看和编辑所有已连接日历
- 通过排程链接或预订页面分享可用时间

立即试用
 CalendarBridge，体验在一个地方管理所有日历的简单方式。这是一款您不知道自己需要、却会想知道过去如何生活的日历同步应用。

payload.name: Tako
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tako helps users find current data and metrics from proprietary datasets and the live web as citation-backed charts, retrieve the underlying result content, check available data coverage, and create shareable public chart links from user-provided structured data.
payload.longDescription: Tako 帮助用户从专有数据集和实时网络中查找当前数据与指标，并生成附带引文的图表；获取底层结果内容、检查可用数据覆盖范围，并根据用户提供的结构化数据创建可分享的公开图表链接。

payload.name: Esment
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Esment gives ChatGPT persistent, inspectable memory for facts, preferences, decisions, and project context. It can recall relevant context, save durable information, update or forget memories, and read organized pages (created locally, not yet available in the cloud) and memory blocks belonging to the authenticated user.
payload.longDescription: Esment 为 ChatGPT 提供可检查的持久记忆，用于保存事实、偏好、决策和项目背景。它可以回忆相关上下文、保存长期有用的信息、更新或遗忘记忆，并读取属于已认证用户的整理页面（在本地创建，尚未提供云端版本）和记忆区块。

payload.name: Evernote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.

Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: NoClick
payload.description: 构建并运行 AI 工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, test, and deploy automated workflows. NoClick makes automation accessible — connect your favorite tools, add logic and AI steps, and let your workflows save your time.

payload.name: Vertical Bar Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vertical Bar Agent helps authorized teams inspect CrossCheck snapshots and process-mining data, analyze dependencies and telemetry, build grounded Briefings, manage test suites and release packages, and run governed NetSuite workflows through ChatGPT. payload.name: Giraffe
payload.description: 让 AI 项目保持清晰
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.

When plans change, Giraffe helps preserve the latest agreed state, what changed, and which earlier information was replaced—so you can continue working without searching through old chats or rebuilding context.

payload.name: B2 Portal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: B2 Portal turns customer emails, notes, transcripts, and attachments into review-ready CoreBridge V2 RFQs. payload.name: Jamie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your meetings into ChatGPT. Ask about your work, draw on conversation context, and get work done.
payload.longDescription: 将你的会议带入 ChatGPT。询问工作相关问题，利用对话上下文，高效完成工作。

payload.name: Sonjapgo
payload.description: 借助 AI 延续项目
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sonjapgo connects ChatGPT to your projects, tasks, shared working documents, work reports, and private thought branches. Users can find and continue current work, create projects and tasks, record and complete work, and safely preview, apply, inspect, or restore line-level document changes through authenticated workflows. payload.longDescription: Sonjapgo 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的项目、任务、共享工作文档、工作报告和私人思路分支。用户可以查找并继续当前工作、创建项目和任务、记录并完成工作，还可以通过经过身份验证的工作流安全地预览、应用、检查或还原文档中逐行的更改。Sonjapgo 会持续关联项目上下文，让 ChatGPT 能依据最新的项目、任务、文档和报告信息开展工作。

payload.name: StewAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StewAI helps people discover approved AI workflows, preview their required inputs, estimate credits, run selected workflows, and retrieve declared final results without managing an API key.
payload.longDescription: StewAI帮助用户发现已批准的AI工作流，预览所需输入，预估资源消耗，运行选定的工作流，并获取声明的最终结果，而无需管理API密钥。

payload.name: Word Counter

Returns words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time. Includes an in-chat widget for quick visual summary. Text is processed in memory and not stored. payload.name: Notit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search across your Notit courses, lectures, Notes, Final Notes, and transcripts without choosing a course first. Read complete notes or original transcript passages, then get answers with links to the source in Notit. You can also review exam points and Quick Reviews. payload.name: AI Detector by AI GPT Zero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中检查论文、研究报告、文章和专业文档是否存在AI生成写作的迹象。这款AI检测工具会分析你提供的文本，返回AI及人类写作的可能性评分、句子级高亮和审阅建议。交互式工作区将原文和检测结果放在一起，便于清晰、专注地审阅。

审阅可能含有AI生成内容的文本时，可将其用作 ChatGPT 检测工具；检查学术文稿时，可用作AI论文检测工具；检查编辑及商业文档时，可用作AI内容检测工具。它将总体评分和各句高亮汇集在同一视图中，支持AI写作审阅，帮助你识别需要进一步关注的段落。

将文本粘贴到工作区，运行AI检测扫描，并阅读总体评估。检查高亮句子、考虑审阅建议，并结合周围段落比较结果。这一文本检查流程帮助你从是否可能使用AI的一般性问题，深入到具体段落的细致检查。

教育工作者和研究人员可使用AI文本检测工具辅助审阅论文、作业、研究报告、文献综述和其他学术写作。应结合草稿、引用、源材料、作业要求及与作者的沟通来考虑检测结果。句子级AI检测为在学术语境中理解文本提供额外参考。

编辑、出版商、记者和内容团队可检查投稿文章、博客文章、新闻简报、评论文章和编辑稿件中是否可能含有AI生成内容。在编辑审阅中使用AI内容检测工具，识别需要向作者进一步核实的部分，并让讨论以所提供的文本为依据。

营销和SEO团队可审阅网站文案、落地页文本、产品描述、营销活动内容和客户交付成果。业务团队可检查报告、提案和其他专业写作。同样的AI写作检测流程帮助审阅人员检查收到的文本，判断哪些地方需要更多背景信息或作者说明。

无论你需要研究文稿的AI文本检测、文章的GPT检测，还是商业内容的AI生成文本检测，工作区都将总体评估与句子级细节结合起来。审阅可能由AI撰写的内容、检查高亮段落，并利用结果引导更有依据的内容讨论。

检测结果属于估计，应结合上下文和人的判断进行解读。

payload.name: Page2AI
payload.description: 将公开网页转换为 Markdown
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. payload.longDescription: Page2AI 会将单个公开网页（仅限你明确提供的 URL）转换为适合大型语言模型上下文的整洁 Markdown：提取主要内容并去除模板杂项，同时保留标题、代码块、表格和链接；还可选择添加包含来源 URL 和标题的 YAML 前置元数据。按需运行且只读：不会爬取网页、不需要账户，也不会由应用存储数据。它不会绕过付费墙、登录、速率限制或任何网站的访问控制；会拒绝私有网络和云元数据 URL；响应上限为 10 MB，并强制实施超时和按 IP 限速。相同的 MIT 许可引擎也可作为本地 MCP 服务器使用（npx -y page2ai-mcp），适用于完全私密的工作流。

payload.name: Redpine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Web search returns abstracts, paywalls, and citations that cannot be checked. Redpine returns the relevant chunk of the document.

Redpine licenses full-text research directly from publishers and research institutions, and serves it to ChatGPT/Codex over MCP alongside a large open-access corpus. One query searches both.

Provenance by default. Every result carries its publisher, title, publication date, and a resolvable identifier such as a DOI. Licensed content and open-access content are labeled separately, so the two are never confused inside an answer.

You see the price first. Any search can be previewed for free. ChatGPT/Codex sees the title, source, and a snippet of every result, plus the exact cost to unlock them, then asks before spending anything. Unlock the three results that matter instead of the 30 that came back. The same results re-fetch free for seven days. Discovery, schema inspection, previews, and balance checks are always free.

Built for questions where being wrong is expensive. Clinical decisions, systematic review, research engineering, and any analysis that has to survive a source check.

An account can also hold data integrations beyond literature. ChatGPT/Codex reads what that account is entitled to at runtime rather than assuming a fixed tool list.

Compensation flows back to the rights holders. New accounts get free queries. Credits are bought on the Redpine dashboard, and the connector never handles payment details: it shows the price and asks before anything is charged.

Requires a Redpine account. Sign-in is OAuth on first use.

payload.name: GovQuery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).
payload.longDescription:
GovQuery 是一款强大的搜索引擎，让美国政府报告和数据更容易探索、查找和理解。

GovQuery 由 Program Integrity Alliance 构建，处理超过 300,000 篇文章、报告和监督建议，使其更便于 AI 平台理解；相比通用搜索引擎，它提供更深入、更有针对性的搜索。每条结果都链接到内容所在的确切页面，你还可以使用源平台不提供的细分分类进行筛选。

目前的数据来源包括：

- Government Accountability Office（GAO）、联邦监察长（Oversight.gov）和 Congressional Research Service（CRS）的报告
- 美国司法部新闻稿
- 行政命令（最近六任总统任内）
- 联邦机构年度 CJ/AFR/PAR 报告（针对《1990 年首席财务官法案》（CFO Act of 1990）的机构，自 2019 年起）

GovQuery 还收录 GAO 和联邦监察长（Oversight.gov）所有尚未结案的监督建议，并提供按类别分析和追踪趋势的工具。

我们会定期添加新的数据来源。

你可以在 https://www.programintegrity.org 注册免费账户（点击右上角的人像图标）。

有关 GovQuery 数据的更多信息，请参阅常见问题解答（https://www.programintegrity.org/faq）。

payload.name: Pantry Persona
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your kitchen inside ChatGPT: recipes, a weekly meal plan, and a grocery list built from what's already at home.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week.

Meal plans: Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically and carry per-meal nutrition.

Recipes: Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group favorites into collections.

Shopping lists: Visual, interactive lists organized by store. Ask for one from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry; check items off with one tap and send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

Cook Mode: Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

Household: Profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets, and every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them. Invite family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Nutrition: See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

Receipts and staples: Pantry Persona tracks expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, and learns the brands and prices you buy. Grocery receipts become an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

A guided setup gets a new kitchen planned and shopped in a few questions.
payload.longDescription:
你的厨房入驻ChatGPT：食谱、每周膳食计划以及基于家中现有食材生成的购物清单。

Pantry Persona会记住冰箱里的食材、家人可食用与禁忌的食品，以及偏好的品牌，随后在你整周烹饪和购物过程中始终保持同步。

膳食计划：通过一次操作生成整周膳食，或逐日逐步构建。计划会自动遵循家庭的饮食偏好和规则，并包含每餐的营养信息。

食谱：可保存网站、烹饪视频或社交帖子中的食谱，或通过对话创建食谱。可根据食材、菜系或当前手头食材可制作的菜品进行搜索，并将收藏的食谱分组整理。

购物清单：按商店分类的可视化互动清单。从膳食计划生成清单时会自动跳过已存在于储物柜的物品；点击即可勾选商品，准备购买时可直接发送至Instacart。

烹饪模式：开始烹饪食谱后可获得分步指导。完成烹饪后，食材会从储物柜中扣除，剩余食材会记录保质期。

家庭成员：资料档案存储每位家庭成员的饮食偏好、饮食规则、喜爱品牌和营养目标，所有建议、计划和搜索都会通过这些信息进行筛选。可邀请家庭成员加入，所有人可实时共享同一份储物柜、食谱和购物清单。

营养数据：在每道食谱和每餐中查看卡路里和宏量营养素，为每位家庭成员设定每日目标，并查看当天或当周的累计情况。记录你实际摄入的食物，即使是在外就餐，都会计入总摄入量。

收据与日常用品：Pantry Persona会追踪保质期，预测日常用品即将用尽的时间，并学习你常购买的品牌和价格。购物收据将转化为实时库存，清晰呈现你的消费情况。

引导式设置功能可通过几个问题，快速完成新厨房的规划与采购。

payload.name: ShotPulled
payload.description: 追踪并调校意式浓缩咖啡
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.
payload.longDescription:
一步一步调校出更好的意式浓缩咖啡。
一次性设置好咖啡豆、磨豆机、意式咖啡机和秤。每次萃取后，记录粉量、液重、萃取时间和口感。ShotPulled 会综合考虑全部情况（包括咖啡豆的新鲜度和磨豆机的校准方式），然后推荐下一杯最值得尝试的一项调整并说明原因。
ShotPulled 还会自动准确记录咖啡库存。每次记录的用粉量都会从咖啡豆袋库存中扣除，因此你可以查看剩余克数，并根据实际用粉量估算还能萃取几杯。它还会追踪咖啡豆的风味巅峰期，显示剩余巅峰天数和该时段结束日期。
配方成功后，可以将其锁定并随时调用。ShotPulled 支持以刻度、编号调节环、复合环位（例如 1.2.2）和命名档位记录磨豆机设置，并内置 67 款磨豆机、124 款意式咖啡机和 24 款秤的规格。
你的 ShotPulled 账户会在 ChatGPT、网页版控制面板和 iPhone 应用之间同步。在这里登记一袋咖啡豆，等你准备好萃取下一杯时，它就已经在手机上等你了。

payload.name: HOUSE ’N’ STARS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for ChatGPT.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

The app helps ChatGPT access public property data such as title, location, property type, Sale/Rent status, price display, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, features and public listing URL.

Listings are supplied by professional real estate agencies admitted to the HOUSE ’N’ STARS platform. The platform applies a curation and quality-control layer to support reliable discovery, structured presentation and a consistent user experience.

The connector is strictly read-only and public-data-only. It does not create, edit, delete, reserve, buy, sell or publish properties. It does not request or process sensitive personal data, payment details, identity documents, financial documents or precise user location. It also does not provide legal, financial, valuation or investment advice.

payload.name: Fellow.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access and act on your meeting knowledge instantly. Fellow connects ChatGPT to your meeting ecosystem, letting you search transcripts, pull key insights from summaries, and track action items with natural-language queries. You can also add talking points, notes, and follow-ups straight to your meeting agendas, so you walk into every meeting prepared.

Need to recall decisions from last quarter? Looking for action items assigned to your team? Want to reference that brilliant idea from yesterday's brainstorm, or add it to next week's agenda? Simply ask ChatGPT and skip the endless scrolling through notes.

Get the clarity you need, exactly when you need it, with Fellow's secure, centralized meeting intelligence.
payload.longDescription:

payload.longDescription:
Ragic插件可为ChatGPT提供对Ragic数据库的只读访问权限，包括任何记录相关的评论和邮件对话。连接成功后，ChatGPT可利用真实业务数据分析趋势、标记需要跟进的内容，并帮助你制定下一步行动方案。

Ragic是一个无代码AI平台，可用于构建自定义数据库系统——包括客户关系管理（CRM）、库存管理、项目追踪等。

payload.name: Lara Translate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lara Translate brings professional-grade, context-aware translation directly into OpenAI.

Use Lara to translate text between supported languages, detect source languages, and work with translation memories and glossaries from your Lara Translate account. The app supports translation styles, contextual instructions, terminology control, adaptive memories, privacy options, HTML and XLIFF content, and Lara Think reasoning for higher-quality translation decisions.

It is designed for users and teams who need reliable multilingual output, consistent terminology, reusable translation assets, and translation workflows that can be automated from inside OpenAI.
payload.longDescription:
Lara Translate 将专业级的上下文感知翻译直接引入 OpenAI。

使用 Lara 进行跨支持语言的文本翻译，检测源语言，并使用来自 Lara Translate 账户的翻译记忆库和术语表。该应用支持翻译风格、上下文指令、术语控制、自适应记忆库、隐私选项、HTML 和 XLIFF 内容，以及 Lara Think 推理以实现更高质量的翻译决策。

该工具专为需要可靠多语言输出、一致术语、可重复使用的翻译资源，以及可在 OpenAI 内部自动化的翻译工作流的用户和团队设计。

payload.name: There's An AI For That
payload.summaryOriginal: Find AI tools for any task
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: There's An AI For That helps users search a public directory of AI tools, filter and rank matches, and inspect detailed tool information and links.
payload.longDescription: 凡事皆有AI帮助用户搜索公共目录中的AI工具，筛选和排序匹配结果，并查看详细的工具信息和相关链接。

payload.name: DomainWisp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate brandable business-name ideas in ChatGPT, then verify live domain availability across popular extensions. DomainWisp returns registry check times, registration and renewal prices, premium status, registrar, and source so you can compare realistic options before choosing a name.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中生成可注册的品牌名称创意，然后验证热门域名后缀的实时可用性。DomainWisp会提供注册局检查时间、注册和续费价格、溢价状态、注册商及数据源，让您在选择名称前对比真实可选方案。

payload.name: ReverseGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReverseGPT humanizes AI-generated text so it reads naturally while preserving meaning, facts, and formatting. It supports up to 1,000 words per call, optional Ultra processing for eligible plans, and free polling for unfinished jobs. Credit-based plans use one ReverseGPT credit per input word. Max includes humanization without deducting credits. Credits deducted for failed runs are refunded.
payload.longDescription: ReverseGPT能将AI生成的文本转化为自然流畅的表达，同时保留原意、事实和格式。该工具每轮处理最多1000个字，符合条件的计划可选超精度处理模式，未完成任务可享受免费轮询服务。按信用计费的计划每输入一个字消耗一个ReverseGPT信用点，高级版可实现人性化处理且不扣减信用点，失败运行扣除的信用点将被全额退还。

payload.name: Codelit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn an idea into a focused Product Plan, practical System Architecture, and supervised Agent Team. Define first-release scope, user journeys, components, data flows, tool permissions, handoffs, approval gates, and tests. Connect reviewed work into an implementation plan or a scoped Codex handoff.

Five planning skills are complemented by a public, read-only MCP server that lists four Codelit workflows and retrieves bundled Markdown planning templates with canonical collection links. No sign-in is required. The server does not access Codelit accounts, accept private drafts, save content, run independent agents, or deploy software. Templates are bundled reference material, not live account data.
payload.longDescription:
将一个想法转化为专注的产品计划、实用的系统架构和受监督的代理团队。定义首版发布范围、用户旅程、组件、数据流、工具权限、交接流程、审批节点和测试用例。将审核后的成果连接到实施计划或限定范围的Codex交接文档。

五项规划技能搭配一个公开只读的MCP服务器，该服务器展示四种Codelit工作流并获取包含规范集合链接的捆绑Markdown规划模板。无需登录即可使用。该服务器不会访问Codelit账户、接收私有草稿、保存内容、运行独立代理或部署软件。模板是捆绑的参考资料，而非实时账户数据。

payload.name: Chop it
payload.description: 饮食计划器、食谱与美食
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chop It is a UK meal-planning app that does the food admin so you can just cook. Tell it what you fancy, or what’s in the fridge, and it builds your week of dinners from a catalogue of more than 1,000 recipes, then turns them into one sorted shopping list you can send straight to your online basket. The Weekly Diversity Score keeps variety, fibre and plants on the plate without giving up the comfort food you want on a Tuesday night. Plan less, cook more, shop once.
payload.longDescription: Chop It 是一款英国餐食规划应用，帮你处理饮食管理，让你只管烹饪。告诉它你想要什么，或者冰箱里有什么食材，它会从超过1000种食谱的目录中为你规划一周的晚餐，再将这些食谱生成一份整理好的购物清单，直接发送到你的在线购物车。每周多样性评分功能能确保餐盘中既有多样性、膳食纤维和植物性食物，又不会放弃你周二晚上想吃的舒适食品。少计划，多烹饪，一次购物。

payload.name: MeetNotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MeetNotes turns meetings into minutes. Record in the room on your phone, send the MeetNotes Notetaker into a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams call, or capture calls with the desktop app. MeetNotes returns a speaker-labelled transcript plus minutes of meeting — summary, key points, decisions and action items with owners — in 100+ languages, including meetings that switch language mid-sentence.

With this plugin you connect your MeetNotes account and ask about your meetings in plain words: what was decided, who owes what, and where exactly something was said, with links that open the moment in the app. Attach an audio file to have it transcribed, paste a meeting link to send the notetaker, and export minutes as PDF, Word or Markdown. It only sees meetings your account can already see; you approve the connection on a MeetNotes page and can end it from ChatGPT at any time.
payload.longDescription:
MeetNotes将会议转化为会议记录。
可在手机上现场录音，将MeetNotes Notetaker发送至Zoom、Google Meet或Microsoft Teams会议，或通过桌面应用记录通话。
MeetNotes会生成带发言者标签的逐字稿以及会议记录——包含摘要、关键点、决策内容及责任人行动项，支持100多种语言，包括中途切换语言的会议。

通过此插件可连接您的MeetNotes账户，用自然语言询问会议相关内容：哪些决策被通过、谁需要完成什么任务、某句话具体是在什么时间点说的，且链接可直接跳转至应用中的对应时间点。
可上传音频文件进行转写，粘贴会议链接即可发送记录工具，支持将会议记录导出为PDF、Word或Markdown格式。
该插件仅能访问您账户已有的会议记录；您需要在MeetNotes页面批准连接操作，且可随时通过ChatGPT终止连接。

payload.name: AI TeamsMaestro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your meetings contain decisions, commitments, and context that your AI assistant can't access. TeamsMaestro changes that by connecting your entire meeting history to ChatGPT.

The fastest growing AI note taker for Microsoft users, TeamsMaestro joins your calls on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom, automatically capturing everything so nothing gets lost.

Works great for:

- Proposals and docs grounded in what was actually discussed in meetings
- Client call preparation by surfacing everything from past sessions, then going deeper with ChatGPT
- Performance reviews backed by real context and commitments from past conversations
- Missed meeting catch-ups with the ability to ask ChatGPT follow-up questions
- Engineering workflows enriched with project background, requirements, and technical decisions from planning meetings
- Strategic analysis that combines meeting insights with documents and data


Instead of copy-pasting transcripts into ChatGPT and hoping it finds the right detail, TeamsMaestro gives your AI direct access to your meeting history. It pulls exactly what it needs, cites the right conversation, and keeps you focused on the work.
payload.longDescription:
您的会议包含决策、承诺和背景信息，这些是您的AI助手无法访问的。TeamsMaestro通过将您的完整会议历史连接到ChatGPT来改变这一现状。

作为增长最快的Microsoft用户AI笔记工具，TeamsMaestro可接入Microsoft Teams、Google Meet和Zoom会议，自动记录所有内容以防信息丢失。

适用于：

- 基于会议实际讨论内容的提案和文档
- 通过提取过往会话内容进行客户通话准备，再通过ChatGPT深入分析
- 依托过往对话中的真实背景和承诺进行绩效评估
- 错过会议后可通过向ChatGPT提问进行补救
- 通过整合规划会议中的项目背景、需求和技术决策优化工程流程
- 结合会议洞察与文档数据进行战略分析

无需将对话记录复制粘贴到ChatGPT并祈祷它找到正确细节，TeamsMaestro让您AI直接访问会议历史。它会精准提取所需内容，引用正确对话记录，让您专注核心工作。
